notes.title: Fatemyth Update V1.1.1-V1.1.2
notes.notes:
This update addresses several bugs. If you encounter any issues during gameplay, feel free to report them in the discussion area or join our community.

Here are the specific updates:

Bug Fixes:

[olist]
[*] Fixed the card misalignment issue when loading saves in dungeons.
[*] Adjusted some skills of Zi Ying in the final chapter.
[*] Corrected various text errors.
[*] Fixed the error and crash issue when loading dungeon saves.
[*] Resolved the equipment sorting issue in the inventory.
[/olist]

Optimizations:

Improved the timing of Xin Jiao's Heart Moon Fox skill activation.

Thank you for your continued support and happy gaming!

notes.title: After the update, you can wear decorations for DM！
Fatemyth Update V1.1.0: Optimized Save Function
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Thanks to everyone's support and feedback, we have made adjustments to parts of the game that could lead to a less enjoyable experience. With the update to version 1.1.0, game saves can now record players' real-time progress. Additionally, upon first completion, players will receive prompts for achieving other endings.

Here are the specific updates:

New Features:

[list]
[*] Added the ability to customize outfits for the DM;
[*] Implemented an automatic backup save feature.
[/list]

Adjustments:
[list]
[*] Tweaked certain storyline texts.
[/list]

Optimizations:

[olist]
[*] Enhanced the save function to store progress in dungeons;
[*] Improved and adjusted some monsters` buff effects;
[*] Streamlined the unlocking process for multiple endings. After the first completion, the quest log will regularly display conditions for achieving other endings;
[*] Enhanced English localization content.
[/olist]

notes.title: Fatemyth Update Version1.0.3-1.0.4
notes.notes:
Dear players,

With your support and feedback, we have fixed the issues in the game and added some new features to enhance everyone's experience. After updating to version 1.0.4,

[list]
[*] You can now directly challenge the bosses in dungeons (Teleport panels are online, and equipment acquisition speed is increased!)
[*] During plotlines with numerical judgments, you will now see real-time values.
[*] Added equipment encyclopedia feature (you can now see the source of each equipment).
[*] After clearing the game, you will be able to keep equipment and gold to start New Game Plus (achievement enthusiasts rejoice!). Here are the specific steps:
[/list]

Open the game--Load your save file---Select the highlighted completed save file
---Click on the gear icon in the top right corner---Click on the "New Game Plus" option
---Continue the game and select the highlighted inherited save file

Here are the detailed updates:

New Features:

[olist]
[*] Added boss battle dungeons, allowing direct challenges to bosses in dungeons.
[*] Added New Game Plus save file inheritance, requires using a completed save file for inheritance.
[*] Added numerical display for options in some dungeons.
[*] Added equipment encyclopedia feature.
[/olist]

Optimizations:

[olist]
[*] Optimized shuffling animation.
[*] Improved loading speed.
[*] Enhanced logic for the mission "Female Summoner's Clay Shatterer."
[*] Enhanced combat logic for "Wind of the Fowl."
[/olist]

Adjustments:

[olist]
[*] Fixed several typos.
[*] Adjusted logic for options in the mission "Congratulatory Baton" for character Xinjiao.
[*] Adjusted some equipment effects.
[*] Tweaked skills for certain bosses in the post-Xinyin chapter.
[/olist]

[h2][b]Update V1.0.2[/b][/h2]
After this version update, based on everyone's feedback, we have added the "Skip Animation" option (no need to watch DM shuffling cards anymore!) and the Text Review feature (you can review text if needed). Here are the specific updates:

Additions:
[*] Added screen saturation adjustment function.
[*] Added screen contrast adjustment function.
[*] Added skip animation function.
[*] Added text review function.

Fixes:
[*] Fixed issues with some equipment effects.
[*] Corrected several typos in the text.

Adjustments:
[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the first secret camp dungeon for the character Xinjiao.
[*] Adjusted the BUFF effect of the character Baiqi.
[*] Adjusted the values of some monsters in the final chapter of Ziyang.
[*] Adjusted the number of gold coins dropped by monsters.

——————
[h2][b]Version Update 1.0.1 for Fate:[/b][/h2]

This version update may cause players currently in-game to experience crashes, which is a normal occurrence. If players encounter this issue, updating the game to V1.0.0 and verifying the game integrity should allow them to play normally.

Update Content:
[*] Side quest "Tiger Stick Chicken" adjustment: now only requires successful completion once to pass.

[b]Please note![/b]
The alpha English version of Fatermyth is now live! This is an initial English release, and there may be some text overflow and bugs with mixed languages in the storyline. However, this won't affect the main gameplay. We will address these issues in future updates. Thank you for your support!

[*] Vice-captain Jiaoxin's subplot options adjustment at Jingfang: now only requires choosing the correct option to pass.
[*] Added English version: now you can enjoy the game in English!

Fixes:
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect equipment descriptions.
[*] Fixed issues with some equipment effects not taking effect.
[*] Added automatic save points in free dungeons.
[*] Corrected typos in the text.

——————
[h2][b]Patch v1 Update 4.23[/b][/h2]
1.Added the function of automatically rolling the dice in the first round, which needs to be enabled in the settings.
2.Added the feature of long-pressing the right mouse button on battle cards to discard all dice on the cards.
3.Corrected some text errors.
4.Fixed some equipment functions.
